risk.summary: Harbourside Precision Engineering Ltd presents a strong credit profile with a 7‑year loan of £1.2m secured by a first legal charge over a freehold factory valued at £1.85m, resulting in an LTV of 64.9% and a DSCR of 1.65. The borrower has 12 years of trading, low leverage (net debt/EBITDA 1.9), and complies with all policy covenants and KYC requirements. The only residual concerns are the partial personal guarantee limited to £300k and reliance on a single property as security. Given the comfortable headroom on key ratios, the deal merits an approval with standard monitoring.
